title: search min 27 chars persist query
rule: Search field as wide as possible, minimum 27 characters (Romance languages ~20% longer). Preload the original terms in the results search box. Magnifying glass is enough visually if “Search” remains for AT.
pass_when: Field is ≥27 characters wide; results page still shows the query; accessible name remains “Search” if the visible label is icon-only.
fail_when: Narrower than 27 characters; query not persisted on results; icon-only with no AT name.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: Placeholder-as-label; advanced search as default (next row).
